issues.title: Invisible Lists
issues.body:
Hi everyone!

Noticed this small bug: 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/198851291-91049c53-4634-4a4c-80c0-7e9e680630d1.mp4

The lists seem to be invisible for all the features. The one under "Type" won't open.

comments.body:
Also, canceling a message doesn't seem to put the window in a default state, rather it stays under "Land Activity": 

[de298c73-8e89-4271-99b6-e6980eea8415.webm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/198851420-990b05c2-a4a8-46e6-bc19-7e1a775277b8.webm)

Ok.  The "empty lists" is because the template for `land activity` doesn't currently match the content of the object we're providing. So, the editor form tries to create controls "on the fly".

But, your second issue is valid.  When the user presses `Cancel`, then we should wipe the form (and clear the form contents from the cache).  Can you look into this please @lilitkarapetyan ?
